profile.text:
Frostleaf is a former Columbian Junior Army soldier, 'retired' after her unit was destroyed. Came into contact with Rhodes Island later as a mercenary, before officially joining following a period of collaboration with the company. 
Extensive combat experience and undeniably skilled, Frostleaf is an excellent asset to Rhodes Island.
